subject: E-Commerce
title: Dark Stores and Ghost Kitchens
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Dark Stores and Ghost Kitchens.

hook.text: Dark stores look like regular shops from outside but have no customers inside.

buildup.text: Gopuff, Getir, and Gorillas opened Ks of dark stores in cities worldwide. Fast grocery delivery boomed during COVID.

discovery.text: Dark stores locate in cheap retail space and stock 2,000-3,000 items. Riders pick and deliver orders in 10-15 minutes.

twist.text: Most quick commerce companies lost billions and closed. Getir, Flink, and Jokr all contracted dramatically after 2022.

climax.text: 15-minute delivery was a solution looking for profitable demand. Speed is valued but not at the cost of higher prices.

punchline.text: 15-minute delivery, billions burned. Consumers wanted speed but wouldn't pay.

quiz.question: Why did most quick-commerce dark store companies fail?
options: The cost of 15-minute delivery was higher than what consumers would pay, making it unprofitable
